notes.title: Play the Demo – The Golden Light Guardian
notes.content: [p][b]The Demo is Finally Here![/b][/p][p][/p][p]The demo for [i]The Golden Light Guardian[/i] is now available![/p][p][/p][p]My wish has always been to create a game as fun and memorable as the ones I’ve enjoyed over the years.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for playing! i really appreciate playing my game.[/p][p][/p][p]Kickstarter - [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gbae/the-golden-light-guardian"]The Golden Light Guardian by Gijun — Kickstarter[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Reddit - [url="https://www.reddit.com/r/TheGoldnLightGuardian/"]TheGoldnLightGuardian[/url][/p]

notes.title: Demo Releases June 24th
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]After much thought, I’ve decided to step back from participating in Steam Next Fest.[/p][p]As a solo developer working on an open-world game, I’ve been pushing hard over the past two months often working around the clock to bring this world to life. But despite all the progress, I feel the current demo isn’t polished enough to deliver the experience I want you to have.[/p][p]This game is incredibly personal to me, and I want your first impression to feel fun, immersive, and rewarding not rushed or unfinished.[/p][p]The demo is plan to release on [b]Tuesday, June 24th[/b].[/p][p]I hope this short delay gives me the breathing room to apply that final layer of polish. I'm truly sorry.[/p][p]Thank you for reading this.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45041208/e57f7f5c8bd245f955d7b5a9afd2eff4d17a95b5.png"][/img][/p]
